title: Match the Canvas, Not Just the Answer: Predictability-Aware SFT for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible parallel generation by resolving tokens according to the model's evolving predictability rather than a fixed left-to-right order. This flexibility, however, introduces training choices absent from standard autoregressive teacher forcing: which reference tokens are visible when a target is supervised and how much generation space is allocated. Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) typically makes these choices through random masking, independently of inference. Our analysis shows how this training-inference mismatch can misdirect supervision. Random masking can conceal prediction errors or penalize uncertainty that decoding would otherwise resolve, while the attention-visible input length can change which response formulations the model favors, even when the underlying solution is unchanged. translated_title: 匹配画布，而不只是匹配答案：面向扩散语言模型的预测性感知监督微调
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）能够实现灵活的并行生成，其方式是依据模型不断演变的可预测性来解析token，而非遵循固定的从左到右的顺序。然而，这种灵活性引入了标准自回归教师强制中并不存在的训练选择：在监督某个目标时哪些参考token可见，以及分配多大的生成空间。标准的监督微调（SFT）通常通过随机掩码来做出这些选择，且独立于推理过程。我们的分析表明，这种训练与推理之间的不匹配会如何误导监督信号。随机掩码可能掩盖预测错误，或惩罚那些在解码时本可以被解决的不确定性；而注意力可见的输入长度则可能改变模型所偏好的响应表述方式，即使底层的解并未改变。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了预测性感知画布选择与监督（Predictability-Aware Canvas Selection and Supervision，PAC……）（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示了扩散语言模型中标准SFT因随机掩码导致的训练与推理不匹配会误导监督信号，并提出预测性感知的画布选择与监督方法，依据模型可预测性来决定训练时可见的参考token与生成空间分配，使训练与解码过程对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the training-inference mismatch caused by random masking in standard SFT misdirects supervision for diffusion language models, and proposes Predictability-Aware Canvas Selection and Supervision, which aligns training with decoding by selecting visible reference tokens and generation space according to the model's evolving predictability.
